name: catalog-roomaware-simple
description: CATALOG-ROOMAWARE: entering a bedroom lands the catalog on Beds, entering the kitchen lands it on Appliances, a manual tab pick is respected (not fought), and the flag-off path falls back to today's default. Desktop + mobile, light + dark.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-flag-on
steps.failMessage: catalogRoomAware flag should default ON in Simple mode

steps.name: catalog-visible
steps.failMessage: Catalog drawer did not appear after setCatalogOpen(true)

steps.name: assert-bedroom-lands-on-beds
steps.eval: (function(){ const on = document.querySelector('.cat-rail .chip.on'); const label = on && on.textContent.trim(); if (!label || !label.startsWith('Beds')) throw new Error('expected the Beds tab active on entering the bedroom, got: ' + label); })()

steps.name: manual-override-pick-storage
steps.eval: (function(){ const chip = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cat-rail .chip')].find(c => c.textContent.trim().startsWith('Storage')); if (!chip) throw new Error('Storage chip not found in the rail'); chip.click(); })()

steps.name: verify-manual-pick-sticks
steps.eval: (function(){ const on = document.querySelector('.cat-rail .chip.on'); const label = on && on.textContent.trim(); if (!label || !label.startsWith('Storage')) throw new Error('expected the manually-picked Storage tab to stay active (room-aware default must not fight a user pick mid-session), got: ' + label); })()

steps.name: assert-kitchen-lands-on-appliances
steps.eval: (function(){ const on = document.querySelector('.cat-rail .chip.on'); const label = on && on.textContent.trim(); if (!label || !label.startsWith('Appliances')) throw new Error('expected the Appliances tab active on entering the kitchen, got: ' + label); })()

steps.name: assert-flag-off-keeps-prior-category
steps.eval: (function(){ const on = document.querySelector('.cat-rail .chip.on'); const label = on && on.textContent.trim(); if (!label || !label.startsWith('Appliances')) throw new Error('with catalogRoomAware OFF, entering the bedroom must NOT switch to Beds — the prior (Appliances) selection should stay untouched, got: ' + label); })()
